who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), executor, host round 2 piece "surface image" third pass, port-memo-1113
where: crates/hir-def/src/deps/serve.rs `Served`, `Stored`; crates/hir-def/src/deps/key.rs `KeyWalk`; crates/blaze-cargo/src/serve/unit/deps.rs `Kept`, `images` (`session.walked.walk.clear()` after each serve)
what: Three result types of the dependency serve held `Crate` ids, which die at a commit, and a serve ends in one; every driver that kept them converted to `CrateKey` and back by hand (the hir-def test helper rebuilt the whole `Served` after each give) or cleared the walk after each commit. base-db also had no fallible key-to-crate lookup (`Db::krate` panics), so a kept key that names a removed crate could only panic.
cost: a pass to port the three types and list every user in blaze-cargo and blaze-lower
cause: a type returned by a function of one snapshot was also the type kept across snapshots
class: snapshot-scoped ids in state that outlives the snapshot
prevention: anything kept past a call holds world keys (`CrateKey`), and turns them into ids only through a fallible lookup (`Db::crate_at`) that the kept value's own doc names; a lint banning `Crate` in the fields of a type that is kept across commits would hold it
fix: the three hold `CrateKey`; `store` is `StoreError::Gone` for a key that names no crate; `KeyWalk` rebuilds at a new view; `Db::crate_at` listed for base-db
state: open until the listed base-db, blaze-lower and blaze-cargo changes land
